name: Aether Blast
text:
Requirements You are overflowing.

---
You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast. You direct the blast at one creature within 30 feet, dealing floor(@actor.level/4)d12 force damage with a basic Reflex save save against your nexus DC. The force damage increases by 1d12 at 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.
